findings.title: The rating slope C is correctly derived but mis-cited as a literal Valve constant
findings.detail: The boards cite model/fit.js for C=0.0056000078, but fit.js does not contain that number. The value reproduces to 2e-11 as Q*g(RD) from Valve's published Glicko Q (glicko.js; Q=ln(10)/400=0.005756462732485115) at fit.js default RD=75.0 -> 0.005600007780351016. The derivation is documented correctly in scripts/f7279a54/core.py (VALVE_Q/VALVE_G/VALVE_C); the method-page citations that call C a Valve-published fit.js constant should cite glicko.js + fit.js (RD=75) instead. No probability changes if corrected.

findings.title: Model rows built on Valve 'remnant' roster rows (<3 players)
findings.detail: Valve publishes one row per counted roster, so an organisation can appear several times. Using a sub-five-player remnant overstates the rated opponent. The documented selection rule prefers the full-five, most-recent row. Affected: 1081600 Banda chuya via #373 (ezox, manio) on desk canonical. Example: fixture 1081600 uses Banda Chuya #373 (402 pts, 2 players) instead of #165 (801 pts, full five), flipping the canonical board's model pick to Donstu 86.4% where every full-five desk publishes Banda chuya ~54%.
